coverage.headline: Idaho Men's Basketball Tops Northern Colorado 72-65 Behind Strong Second Half
coverage.recap:
Idaho defeated Northern Colorado 72-65 Wednesday night at the Cowan Spectrum, improving its record with a gritty second-half performance.

The Vandals shot 26-of-58 from the field and connected on 8-of-22 attempts from behind the arc, while Northern Colorado finished 24-of-54 shooting. Idaho's advantage on the glass proved decisive, as the Vandals outrebounded the Bears 38-31 and committed just nine turnovers compared to 15 for Northern Colorado. The free throw line also favored Idaho, which went 12-of-15 from the stripe.

Idaho led throughout the second half and held off a late Northern Colorado push to secure the seven-point victory. The Vandals' 14 assists reflected good ball movement and helped generate open looks from the perimeter throughout the contest.
coverage.spotlight_body: Smith led all scorers with 22 points on 8-of-14 shooting, adding seven rebounds and five assists. His three-point shooting — 4-of-7 from deep — helped Idaho stretch Northern Colorado's defense throughout the contest.
coverage.social_post: Idaho 72, Northern Colorado 65. The Vandals outrebounded the Bears 38-31 and held UNC to 15 turnovers in a conference win. #GoVandals
